articles.title: Gamescom Is the Biggest Gaming Show Ever — and It's Not Stressed About It!
articles.summary: Gamescom is now the world's biggest gaming event, and it's in Germany! They're adding a speedrunning marathon called Games Done Quick. No pressure, they say — just excitement!

articles.title: If You Love 'Silo,' You Should Watch This Hidden Sci-Fi Gem: 'Beacon 23'
articles.summary: The author of 'Silo' also wrote 'Beacon 23,' a space show about a lighthouse in space with two strangers trapped inside. It's short-lived but worth a look!

articles.title: Martin Short Is Mr. Emmy! (And He Has the Home Movies to Prove It)
articles.summary: Martin Short is nominated for three different shows this year! He even let a filmmaker use his old home movies. He says, 'I am Mr. Emmy this year!'
